registered_before: Physical stream/feature access, physical optimizer steps, control outcomes, any H100 call. No physical data or synthetic outcome in this file.
model: Match hero_train.init_model in FP32: 4 hard categories, affine or 54->16 tanh->4 center logits; 772->16 tanh->4 shell logits; interleaved vacancy,A indicators centered .25,.30. The center and shell see no beta, parent IDs, side inventories or each other's features. Expected loss = -mean_i sum_h softmax(center_i)_h * logsoftmax_over_8_candidates(shell)_ih. Deploy argmax separately. Not a continuous bottleneck. Adam (.9,.999), eps=1e-8, lr .0008/sqrt(1+updates/1024), no dropout/EMA/augmentation.
data: Read only released V/E,parent from fit plus even ordinal positions of development (selection). Odd dev is for separate rule selection, exam and index6 are sealed. All translations stay with parent. Every admitted beta equally weighted (including beta=0 in representation). Four study arms = affine/tanh x uniform/matched. No beta dropped for low support.
groups: Exactly 8 groups x 8 different same-beta parents per optimizer update. Successive random-permutation cycles over betas yield per-beta group count discrepancy <=1. Within beta, shuffle each parent once per coverage sweep. Uniform chooses a uniformly random translation; matched chooses a uniformly random supported translation of each parent, buckets assigned anchors by S; never crosses S. Incomplete groups pad without replacement from other parents at same beta (and S), using uniform eligible anchors. Groups shuffled. All 8 members simultaneously positive and negative opportunities, so no position has a different marginal. Rare beta and rare S padding can be oversampled; explicitly count, not iid shell-score samples. Matched S = ((vacancies//3)*8+A//4)*8+occupied_internal_edges//8. Supported S requires >=8 distinct parents. Disclose holes including missing parents. No complete-fit claim on a role/seed without min actual positive parent count >=1. Data support failure blocks all-beta promotion; no coarsening after outcomes.
nested_fit: Per admitted beta take first min(n,max(32,ceil(n/d))) parents in registered shuffled fit-roster order for d=16,4,1 (no rearranging to cherry-pick support). All 64 registered translations available each. Screen all four arms and all 3 fractions on seeds 6101,6102,6103. Pair arms' initializations/seed schedule. Fit 1024,2048,4096,8192 steps and at least one complete positive exposure of all eligible parents in final full fits. Full fraction supported parents receive a genuine full coverage sweep even if continued deeper is needed. No coverage credit for arrays resident on disk/device.
report: At each doubling: elapsed wall and process CPU seconds, actual step count; CUDA event elapsed milliseconds, effective hardware and peak memory only for real CUDA; gradient RMS norms encoder/critic; beta positive slot totals, min/median/max exposure, n distinct, completed sweeps and actual S frequencies. Common score per beta = .5*(uniform hard-argmax nats + matched hard-argmax nats); separately report same exact stochastic-category expectation, entropy H/H|V and I(V;H), hard bit rate, state frequencies on each law. Evaluate fit and even-dev on fixed 512 groups per law per beta using pilot iid law (uniform parent subset/uniform anchor; matched S drawn by empirical retained anchor mass, uniformly chosen 8 distinct parents in S and uniform eligible anchor). Group positions all positives. Macro mean equal beta. No evaluation targets for selection. Pair seed differences and delete 16 fixed whole-parent blocks within each beta, dropping groups with any candidate deleted; missing complement = inadequate precision, not zero. Scores finite-candidate nats, not measured mutual information.
finalists: After screening, carry the best full-fraction arch in EACH objective law by mean common hard dev gain at 8192; ties to affine. Seeds 6104/6105 at full fraction on both finalists. Continue five seed sets by doubling 16384,32768,65536 if feasible until two successive gains <.001 nats with upper 95% <.001 (paired seeds AND delete-parent-block uncertainty), full coverage, no robust dev deterioration; a significant negative change marks overfit, not evidence of inadequate compute. Cap while rising or imprecise => explicitly compute/precision limited. Higher mean full-fraction development score across laws selects representation, ties affine then uniform. Downstream rule checks independent. No favorable fraction/temperature as replacement.
frozen_controls: Same six fixed central comparisons as pilot: origin site, vacancy composition, total internal nn occupancy, Crystal3/5 template max, random affine and random tanh. Fit-only pooled equal-beta quartile cuts (site uses three species). At full fraction match finalists' critic, same-beta law, seed schedule and optimizer steps; no floating logits or center labels; report any compute cap rather than claiming matched opportunity when not achieved.
synthetic_controls: Planted finite pilot alphabet: X is A-at-corner orientation, independent of packing nuisance z; distant Y reports X with correlation rho=.10 weak, .60 strong, full shell shuffle within fake beta and z for null. Ordinary comparator gain=0 and oracle normalized MSE gain=rho^2; enumerate eight-candidate oracle. Four fake betas (balanced pseudo-parent partitions; one independent letter each). Disjoint fit/dev seeds, 131072 independent parents per role, no real rows. Evaluate all four arch/law combos, seed6101 to 8192 actual updates. Recovery thresholds unchanged: common dev expected nats >.001 weak, >.06 strong, <=.0015 shuffle. Normalized MSE gain >.004 weak, >.15 strong, <=.002 shuffle; weak/strong lower 95% >0 and >null upper, both expected scores exceed null. Exhaustive disjoint heldout groups per fake beta, parent-level MSE uncertainty, groups for log-score. No numerical gate = no physical promotion. No tuning/retries on physical inputs. Compare torch and numpy reference per-parameter grads and loss (absolute 2e-6) and initialized per-branch logits for both architectures.
admission: Single H100 80GB only, no substitution; hold paid admission until Main verifies separate gross-cap route. Pilot 256 actual fit-only affine/uniform seed6101 updates from immutable packet.npz, packet.json with true sampled fit parents <=64/beta and 64 anchors. Hard bound 64 MiB file and inflated array sizes; output <128 KiB; no network, retries, mount or spending by this trainer. $25 incremental gross ceiling shared with other study, not reset. Public training-release-1.json and preceding stream digests gate physical runs. If H100 cannot be admitted, CPU fallback at most three independent single-thread torch workers plus one preprocessing worker; publish measured forward+backward CPU timing not fictitious GPU predictions.
